Use case: stylized-concept. Production TRANSPARENT texture atlas for a premium realistic dark gothic black/gold mobile game. Detailed old burgundy leather, aged antique gold fittings and worn creamy parchment, soft material highlights, no external cast shadow, no candles or other props.

Deep burgundy red leather boards, thin ornate gold cornerwork and spine clasp details, two flat BLANK fixed page blocks; both page surfaces are rectangular and level, no curled or raised page, no writing/symbols/pictures/people. TOP RIGHT: ONE detached RECTANGULAR parchment PAGE FRONT texture, 430px wide x600px high, straight edges, blank center, subtle fine paper fibre, warm off-white aged margins, no fold, no curvature, no gold border, no writing or graphics.
